title: Senior Agribusiness Economist
overview: Lead our crop forecasting models, fertilizer price tracking, and value-chain margin analysis across West and East Africa. You will turn raw agronomic and market price data into high-conviction decision frameworks for multinationals and agribusiness funds.
responsibilities: Design and manage field survey models for cereal grains, oilseeds, and farm inputs across 36 trade corridors.
Author flagship industry forecast reports and high-priority executive briefing notes.
Conduct quarterly briefings for agribusiness corporate clients, commercial lenders, and private equity investors.
Mentor junior research fellows on econometric time-series analysis and field sampling methodologies.
qualifications: Master's degree in Agricultural Economics, Quantitative Economics, or related discipline.
Proven track record with time-series modeling using Python, R, or advanced Excel econometric toolkits.
Deep contextual understanding of West African agro-climatic zones, logistics bottlenecks, and farmgate pricing dynamics.
Exceptional writing capability with an aptitude for crafting crystal-clear, executive-grade research summaries.

title: Quantitative Data & Telemetry Engineer
overview: Build and maintain automated data harvesting pipelines integrating port manifests, satellite vegetation indices (NDVI), and macroeconomic registers into our high-frequency intelligence engine.
responsibilities: Build robust, fault-tolerant ETL pipelines using Python and SQL to ingest and standardize multi-country economic and trade datasets.
Create automated statistical validation tests to identify data collection anomalies, outlier spikes, and currency conversion distortions.
Collaborate with senior econometricians to turn complex mathematical equations into automated, client-facing dashboard visualizations.
Architect scalable schema migrations and high-performance API endpoints for institutional enterprise subscribers.
qualifications: Strong proficiency in Python, PostgreSQL, Pandas, and modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect).
Familiarity with geospatial GIS data, satellite imagery (NDVI/Sentinel), or shipping telemetry is a strong advantage.
Passion for immaculate data pipelines, automated testing, and comprehensive documentation.
Comfort working with hybrid pan-African and international development teams in an agile cadence.

title: Macroeconomic Research Analyst
overview: Track central bank monetary policy shifts, inflation dynamics, foreign exchange liquidity, and sovereign debt across regional West and Central African trading blocs.
responsibilities: Monitor daily central bank bulletins, debt issuance calendars, treasury bill auctions, and headline inflation releases.
Maintain and update our proprietary macroeconomic scenario simulation models and interest rate sensitivity matrices.
Draft weekly analytical commentary for The Renalytica Weekly executive briefing newsletter distributed to C-suite subscribers.
Synthesize high-frequency price indices to evaluate real-time purchasing power parity and currency pass-through.
qualifications: Degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, or Actuarial Science.
Sharp analytical mindset with deep curiosity for fiscal, monetary, and exchange rate mechanisms in frontier markets.
Outstanding writing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative theories in plain, engaging English.
Familiarity with financial databases, Bloomberg/Refinitiv terminals, or advanced financial modeling in Excel.

title: B2B Research Sales & Client Relationship Manager
overview: Manage executive relationships with corporate clients, investment funds, commercial banks, and global consultancies purchasing Renalytica research reports and enterprise intelligence subscriptions.
responsibilities: Lead consultative demonstrations of the Renalytica research store, proprietary data feeds, and corporate subscription tiers.
Manage inbound corporate inquiries from senior corporate strategy heads, chief risk officers, and institutional treasurers.
Collaborate closely with research desk heads to scope custom feasibility proposals (RFPs) and bespoke market surveys.
Build enduring partnerships that drive annual subscription renewals and expand seat licenses across client teams.
qualifications: Proven track record in B2B corporate sales, financial services advisory, enterprise software, or consulting services.
Polished executive presence and stellar interpersonal communication skills when speaking with C-suite executives.
High emotional intelligence with a consultative, value-first mindset rather than transactional pushiness.
Strong organizational discipline, pipeline management acumen, and familiarity with modern CRM platforms.
